<section class="pg " id="pg7"><div class="bar"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Cato Digital"><div class="tag">Roadmap</div></div><div class="body"><p style="font:600 19px/1.25 var(--serif);margin-bottom:12px">Know where GPU financings get hurt.</p><div class="risk8"><div class="rk"><b><i>A</i>No firm demand</b><span>Spot pricing or soft commitments.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>B</i>Counterparty credit</b><span>Defaults on long-term obligations.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>C</i>Concentration</b><span>By client or sector.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>D</i>Supply</b><span>Servers late or overpriced.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>E</i>Site and consent</b><span>Power, cooling, or local approval not ready.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>F</i>Build and operations</b><span>Outages, service credits, early exit.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>G</i>Obsolescence</b><span>New GPU gen lowers rental rates &amp; resale value.</span></div><div class="rk"><b><i>H</i>The cycle</b><span>AI spending pulls back before the loan is repaid.</span></div></div></div><div class="foot"><span>GPU equipment financing brief</span><span>7 / 26</span></div></section>

<section class="pg " id="pg23"><div class="bar"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Cato Digital"><div class="tag">The deal</div></div><div class="body"><h2 id="n13"><span class="num">04</span>Deal structure and options</h2><ul class="plain"><li><b>Target.</b> A revolving, delayed-draw facility in a standalone SPV. Each newly signed customer contract becomes a draw request with fast approval, and customer payments repay it.</li><li><b>Other options.</b> A single-tranche loan or lease for the first 22 servers, vendor financing, sale-leaseback, receivables financing against contract invoices, and impact-finance participation.</li></ul><div style="height:18px"></div><ul class="plain"><li><b>Lender incentives.</b> Open to equity kickers, warrants or fee structures for lenders who commit early.</li><li><b>Collateral.</b> Serial-numbered, high-demand servers plus assigned customer payments and deposits. Cato’s legacy business stays outside the structure.</li><li><b>Parent equity.</b> The $10M SAFE (opportunity 2) is raised in parallel: $25M cap, 20% discount, $6.5M committed.</li></ul></div><div class="foot"><span>GPU equipment financing brief</span><span>23 / 26</span></div></section>
